categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Jasic Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the welding and cutting equipment manufacturing industry. Its main business includes the research, development, production, and sales of inverter welding machines, welding and cutting accessories, welding materials, and welding robots. The company offers a wide range of products including MIG/CO2 welding machines, pulse MIG welders, manual arc welders, pulse TIG welders, plasma cutting machines, submerged arc welders, and handheld laser welding machines.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced digital control platforms based on DSP+ARM technology for its welding machines, enabling enhanced welding process performance. It integrates traditional welding techniques with automation and digitalization to increase product value. Production methods include lean manufacturing and intelligent manufacturing with automation equipment to improve labor productivity and product quality. The company also maintains high-standard testing laboratories certified by TUV and CSA for comprehensive product testing and quality assurance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Jasic serves a diverse range of industries including shipbuilding, petrochemical, engineering machinery, vehicle manufacturing, pressure vessels, railway construction, and hardware processing. Its customers are primarily industrial enterprises requiring welding and cutting solutions. The company has a global customer base supported by a worldwide dealer network, with significant sales in both domestic Chinese and international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China with headquarters and multiple subsidiaries across Shenzhen, Chongqing, Chengdu, Changzhou, Huizhou, and other cities. It also has overseas subsidiaries and offices in the United States and Europe (Italy). Its sales cover domestic markets and export markets, with exports accounting for over 50% of revenue, targeting regions including Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jasic operates primarily in the midstream segment of the welding equipment supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and assembling welding machines and related products. It sources raw materials such as electronic components, steel, and non-ferrous metals from upstream suppliers and sells finished products downstream to industrial customers and distributors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in digital and intelligent welding technologies, focusing on developing fully digital welding machines and expanding into high-end and industrial welding markets. Key R&D projects include the DSP+ARM digital control platform, EVO20 series, EVOLVE series with internet connectivity, and handheld laser welding products. Jasic invests heavily in R&D, maintains multiple research centers domestically and abroad, and continuously upgrades its product portfolio to meet evolving market demands.
categories.revenue_model: Jasic generates revenue primarily through product sales of welding machines, accessories, materials, and robots. The company employs an authorized dealer sales model complemented by direct sales. Revenue recognition occurs mainly at the point of delivery and acceptance by customers, including domestic and export sales. The company also earns income from financial investments and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jasic is a leading domestic player in China's welding equipment manufacturing industry, competing with international giants like Lincoln Electric, Miller, ESAB, and Fronius, as well as domestic peers such as Riland and Shanghai Hugong. The company holds a strong position in the mid-to-high-end welding machine market in China, with growing capabilities in industrial welding and digital product lines, supported by robust R&D and brand recognition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Jasic reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.26 billion, representing a 9.9% increase over the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 255 million, up 25.46%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 3.04 billion, growing 5.83% year-over-year. It maintains a stable growth trajectory with continuous investment in R&D and production capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jasic emphasizes providing stable, reliable, and fully digital welding products that integrate traditional craftsmanship with cutting-edge automation and digital technologies. Its value proposition includes comprehensive product lines covering various welding needs, high product quality assured by advanced testing capabilities, and strong after-sales service with nationwide warranty and 24-hour support. The company also focuses on customization and rapid response to customer-specific requirements, enhancing competitiveness in both domestic and international markets.
